== English Decipher comparison ==
Decipher restricts the sandcrawler to yours, specifies a vehicle target and compares against defense value. The 2016 PC wording permits a warrior aboard an enclosed vehicle to fire. The host bonus, protection, firing cost and +2 destiny comparison remain.

Decipher, November 1998, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/f/fb/Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf#page=51 Glossary Version 2.0], PDF page 51. Players Committee, Decipher Errata, official text as of 1 January 2013, PDF page 16. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160809094140id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf#page=16 Internet Archive]. Players Committee, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1036946#p1036946 Vehicle weapon errata], 31 May 2016. Players Committee, June 2017, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/a/a0/PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf#page=15 Decipher Errata slips], PDF page 15.
